notes: The upper calculation is cancelled as a block. It first proposes epsilon_0 epsilon_1 epsilon_infinity = 1, expands that expression using l_i and sigma_i, gives bracket substitutions and a marginal inverse-product reduction, then derives three sigma expressions and the claimed unexpected relation sigma_infinity sigma_1 sigma_0 = 1. These are the author’s cancelled calculations; they are preserved rather than presented as established facts.

The subsequent live text begins Sans doute and writes epsilon_0 epsilon_1 epsilon_infinity = sigma_1, followed by three conjugacy-shaped epsilon relations. The right-hand sigma_1 is clear on the crop despite H’s uncertainty. No mathematical inference was used to supply it or the blackened final index of the first following equation.

The final paragraph criticizes the notation and approach because the listed elements belong to discrete groups that should be distinguished from profinite groups. The actual later phrases are des groupes profini and les groupes discret. Both visible agreement breaks are preserved; no s is supplied from grammar. The preferred final reading has an unclosed parenthesis; the blind audit retains Cat as an alternative to (et.

The C nested uncertainty fixé and the rho/phi alternative in the opening are resolved on the opening crop. Stable remains doubtful under its strike. The first-underbrace upper trial is read l_1 sigma_infinity with a local doubt on the crossed first index and an explicit local deletion; the lower trial l_1^{-1} l_infinity^{-1} sigma_0 is readable and independently struck.

All supplied C deletions and insertions were inspected. The proposed page retains the large cancellation, its opening insertion and cancelled stable, the lower first-bracket cancellation, and the final cancelled utiliser; it adds the separate local cancellation of the upper first-bracket insertion. The final utiliser reading is retained with a new local certainty doubt because its ending is crossed.

The only explicit authorial tentative phrase is Sans doute. No date is present. The manuscript number is 14 at the lower left; it has its own H-omission row and crop. The editorial scan identifier 15 is not source text. The two short divider strokes are reproduced in TikZ.

The source has no commas after the first two sigma equations or after the first two live epsilon equations. H’s four literal equation-separating commas are logged separately from its \, spacing commands, which are macro differences. H’s explanatory notes and additional section heading are excluded from the source transcription.

The whole sheet and both original-resolution halves were read once, followed by fourteen saved first-reading crops. The last two crops concern previously uncropped equation rows needed to document H’s literal punctuation additions. Every numerical display, insertion, marginal note, cancellation, lexical disagreement and remaining doubt has second-reading box coverage. The first page reader used no OCR, external research, other page, TeX compilation or mathematical check. The main reader’s separate computations are recorded below.

Main-reader local computation verifies ε₀ε₁ε∞=σ₁ as automorphisms by comparing their reduced images of l₀ and l₁. It also verifies each of the following three cyclic conjugation formulas, comparing εᵢεⱼ with εⱼεₖ to avoid assuming an inverse-map implementation. The result supports the live revision after Sans doute. It does not change that authorial qualification or the cancelled earlier claim that the product equals 1. The script check_013_015_words.py and its recorded generator images are included.

Because σ₁ sends l₀ to l∞ in the displayed generator model, the checked product is not the identity in that model. This distinguishes the cancelled calculation from the later live revision. The full cancelled block, its locally cancelled underbrace attempts, the boxed formula and the author's OK remain in the diplomatic text.

The blind audit retains the broad upper cancellation and the two local first-bracket cancellations after separating them from the page-wide strokes. A small tick beside the framed formula belongs to a longer cancellation and is not added as a check mark; tiny spots below notations do not establish a colon. The crossed stable/stables ending, aussi/on a and final (et/Cat remain qualified. The live singular profini and discret are preserved. These changes of certainty do not add new mathematical checks.
